content:
iOS 27.3 is coming soon, packed with new features for iPhone users. Here’s when to expect the next big iPhone software update.

iOS 27.3 confirmed to launch in December, likely by mid-month

If you follow Apple closely, the company’s software release patterns quickly become clear.

For example, iOS 27.2 launched late last month around the same time as releases in years past. The only difference is that normally iOS 27.1 would launch in late October rather than 27.2. But since Apple made iOS 27.1 exclusive to iPhone Duo, all software releases for the iOS 27 cycle will be off by one number—despite following the same timing as ever.

That means iOS 27.3 is up next, and its release should align with historic patterns for x.2 updates.

Apple has confirmed that iOS 27.3 will launch to all users in December once beta testing concludes.

To get more precise though, here’s a sampling of release patterns for comparable x.2 updates the last few years:

  • iOS 26.2: Friday, December 12
  • iOS 18.2: Wednesday, December 11
  • iOS 17.2: Monday, December 11

Based on this pattern, iOS 27.3 is expected to release by mid-December.

Apple always tries to ship its last software update of the year with a little buffer before taking a holiday break. That way if any major issues arise, the company can develop a quick fix and push it out before much of the company takes time off.

Expect to see iOS 27.3 launch as early as the week of December 7, or on Monday, December 14 at the latest.

New features coming in iOS 27.3

iOS 27.3 is packed with lots of new features for iPhone users spanning various popular apps.

Here are some of the new features in iOS 27.3:

  • Apple TV: Video podcasts and vertical ‘Clips’ videos
  • Health: All-new redesigned app with many new features
  • Safari: Vertical Tabs, Adaptive Dark Mode, and more
  • Apple Music: Selfie Sing feature and updated lyrics view
  • Siri AI: New in-app actions, languages, and more
  • Calendar: Design updates for one-handed use
  • Fitness: Gym Strength program for Fitness+
  • iCloud+: Expanded AI usage limits and Shortcuts feature

iPhone Duo also benefits from three exciting new features, including face unlock, Reachability, and a new setting to automatically lock the device when closed.

Finally, iOS 27.3 brings the first Apple Intelligence features to China—though Siri AI is still missing.

Which new iOS 27.3 features are you most interested in? Let us know in the comments.
